Venue ki Sahulat

Royal Castle Marriage Hall ki public listing mein jo sahulat wazeh tor par darj hain, wahi yahan likhi gayi hain — koi izafi dawa nahi.

Spacious Marquee

Khula aur spacious marquee setup — stage aur mehmanon ki nashiston ke liye aaram-deh jagah, taake function bhar-pur mehsoos ho, bheerh nahi.

250 Mehmanon Tak

Capacity up to 250 guests — darmiyane size ki shaadi, walima aur baraat ke functions ke liye mozoon, jahan har mehman ko jagah mile.

In-House Catering

Khana venue ki apni in-house catering se — bahar ke caterer ki alag tension nahi, menu aur tasting ke liye hall se direct rabta karein.

Decent Parking

Mehmanon ki gariyon ke liye decent parking ki sahulat — Johar Town ke andar asaan approach ke saath.

Gallery

Ek aam shaadi function ka mahaul kaisa lagta hai, is ka andaza in tasaveer se lagayein.

Hall me kitne mehman aa sakte hain?
Public listing ke mutabiq capacity up to 250 guests hai. Is se zyada tadaad ho to pehle hall se call par tasdeeq kar lein.
Kya khana hall ki taraf se hota hai?
Ji, venue in-house catering faraham karta hai. Menu ki tafseel aur tasting ke liye hall ke number +92 341 9255555 par rabta karein — is demo page par koi menu ya rate nahi diya gaya.
Parking ki sahulat hai?
Ji, listing ke mutabiq mehmanon ke liye decent parking mojood hai.
Apni date kaise check karoon?
Upar diye gaye form se WhatsApp message bhejein ya hall ko direct call karein. Date ki final tasdeeq hall ki taraf se hi hoti hai — ye demo website koi booking confirm nahi karti.
Rates / per-head qeemat kya hai?
Is page par jaan-boojh kar koi qeemat nahi likhi gayi, kyun ke rates date aur menu ke hisab se badalte hain. Sahi rate ke liye hall se direct rabta karein.
